title: DSAL-Egov: reproducibility package for a domain-specific abstraction layer for cross-chain e-government interoperability
description: Synthetic DSAL-Egov Concept Benchmark v1 (5,400 pairs across Hyperledger Fabric, FISCO BCOS and Corda) with a deterministic generator, the two-stage retrieval-and-reranking reference implementation, the evaluation harness and recorded results, the manuscript figure scripts, and the TLA+ coordination model with its TLC model-checking log. Supplementary material to the manuscript 'A Domain-Specific Abstraction Layer for Interoperability across Heterogeneous Blockchain Platforms in E-Government Systems'. All content is synthetic or derived from public platform documentation; no agency, employer or person-level data are included. Code is MIT-licensed and data are CC BY 4.0; the Zenodo record uses CC BY 4.0 as the umbrella licence for the package.
